chunks: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from 'Abd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:
A man who stole from an orchard a date-cluster worth two dirhams—he said: “His hand is cut for it.”

key_terms.بُسْتَانٍ: orchard or garden from which the item was stolen
key_terms.دِرْهَمَانِ: two dirhams, indicating the stated value
key_terms.يُقْطَعُ: the hand is cut; the hadd punishment for theft is carried out

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on stealing property worth two dirhams in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning theft when the stolen item reaches a specified value. It states that stealing a date-cluster from an orchard worth two dirhams entails the hadd punishment of amputation.
